name: A Bouquet For My Botanical Darling
source:
A Bouquet For My Botanical Darling is a vn that pokes fun at magical girl tropes and gives them a realistic teen/ya edge. Plus there are sapphics.

[From [url=https://love-killed-the-superstar.itch.io/abouquet]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一部拿魔法少女套路开玩笑，并加入贴近现实的青少年成长视角的视觉小说。另外还有女同性恋角色。

[引自[url=https://love-killed-the-superstar.itch.io/abouquet]Itch.io[/url]]
